title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
**Internship Opportunity: Flutter Full-Stack Developer – HealthTech Mobile Application**

**Company:** Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** LOBMAX Nephro Companion App  
**Product Category:** HealthTech – Kidney Care & Patient Companion Mobile Application  
**Location:** NIET TBI, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Internship Duration:** 6–12 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹8,000 per month  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time Internship  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Eligibility:** B.Tech / B.E. graduate in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field

About Eitonics Technologies

Eitonics Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing technology startup operating in HealthTech and HospitalityTech, developing digital solutions to address real-world operational challenges.

Our HealthTech product ecosystem includes **LOBMAX Nephro Companion App**, a kidney care-focused mobile application designed to support patients through digital healthcare services, patient engagement, health information management, and improved connectivity with healthcare providers.

We are looking for a technically enthusiastic B.Tech graduate interested in mobile application development and full-stack engineering to join our development team.

The selected candidate will work on building, enhancing, integrating, and maintaining the LOBMAX Nephro Companion App, gaining practical experience in Flutter, Dart, backend API integration, database connectivity, cloud infrastructure, and production application deployment.

Role Overview

As a **Flutter Full-Stack Developer Intern**, you will be directly involved in the development and maintenance of the LOBMAX Nephro Companion App.

This is a practical engineering role, not just a training internship. You will work on actual mobile application features, develop user interfaces, integrate backend APIs, manage application data, troubleshoot bugs, and contribute to building a reliable healthcare mobile application.

You will also gain exposure to backend systems, database management, cloud infrastructure, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities1. Flutter Mobile Application Development

* Develop, maintain, and enhance the LOBMAX Nephro Companion App using Flutter and Dart.
* Build responsive, user-friendly, and reusable mobile application interfaces.
* Develop application screens, dashboards, forms, patient profiles, health information views, and other application modules.
* Implement application navigation, authentication, user sessions, and role-based functionality.
* Integrate REST APIs and handle JSON-based responses.
* Implement state management using Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, GetX, or other suitable solutions.
* Ensure application compatibility across different Android devices and screen sizes.
* Debug application crashes, UI issues, and performance problems.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-structured code.

2. Backend Development & API Integration

* Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs required by the mobile application.
* Connect Flutter applications with backend services and databases.
* Work with authentication, API requests, responses, HTTP methods, and status codes.
* Implement proper API error handling, loading states, and data validation.
* Work with existing backend systems and contribute to backend functionality wherever required.
* Integrate application modules with the healthcare platform's backend.
* Ensure secure communication and data exchange between mobile applications and backend systems.

3. Database Management & Data Handling

* Work with MySQL and understand relational database structures.
* Understand database tables, relationships, SQL queries, and CRUD operations.
* Handle patient-related information and application data through backend APIs.
* Implement local data storage and caching wherever required.
* Work with SQLite, SharedPreferences, Hive, or other suitable storage solutions.
* Ensure appropriate data synchronization between the mobile application and backend.
* Follow data security, privacy, and access-control practices when handling healthcare-related information.

4. Application Deployment & Production Maintenance

* Assist with building and deploying Android applications.
* Generate APK and Android App Bundle (AAB) builds.
* Understand application signing, versioning, and release management.
* Assist with Google Play Console releases and application updates.
* Troubleshoot application issues reported by users.
* Monitor application performance and investigate crashes.
* Work with Git and follow proper version-control practices.
* Assist with backend deployment, Linux VPS environments, and server-side troubleshooting wherever required.
* Maintain technical documentation for application features, integrations, and deployment procedures.

5. Testing & Quality Assurance

* Test application functionality across different Android devices.
* Identify and resolve UI, functional, and API integration bugs.
* Perform basic unit testing and Flutter widget testing.
* Validate application workflows before production releases.
* Investigate application logs and troubleshoot unexpected behavior.
* Improve application stability, responsiveness, and performance.
* Ensure reliable functioning of important patient-facing application features.

Required Technical Skills

* B.Tech / B.E. graduate in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Flutter and Dart.
* Understanding of mobile application development concepts.
* Familiarity with Flutter widgets, layouts, navigation, and responsive UI development.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP methods, and API integration.
* Basic understanding of Flutter state management.
* Knowledge of MySQL, SQL queries, or relational database concepts.
* Understanding of OOP concepts, programming fundamentals, and data structures.
* Familiarity with Git and basic version-control operations.
* Ability to debug code, research solutions, and solve technical problems independently.
* Willingness to learn backend development, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.

Good to Have

* Experience developing and deploying Flutter applications.
* Knowledge of Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, GetX, or other Flutter state management solutions.
* Familiarity with Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging, or other Firebase services.
* Experience integrating REST APIs with Flutter applications.
* Knowledge of PHP, Laravel, Node.js, or other backend technologies.
* Familiarity with MySQL database design and optimization.
* Knowledge of SQLite, Hive, or other local database solutions.
* Understanding of JWT authentication and secure API communication.
* Experience with Android Studio, VS Code, and Android SDK.
* Familiarity with Linux commands, SSH, VPS hosting, and cloud deployment.
* Experience publishing applications through Google Play Console.
* Knowledge of application architecture patterns such as MVC, MVVM, or Clean Architecture.
* GitHub profile containing Flutter projects or academic work.

Stipend & Internship Details

* **Monthly stipend:** ₹8,000.
* **Internship duration:** 6–12 months, depending on performance and project requirements.
* **Location:** NIET TBI, Greater Noida.
* **Work arrangement:** Full-time, work from office.
* **Learning opportunities:** Real-world Flutter application development, healthcare mobile application development, REST API integration, backend connectivity, database management, application deployment, and production support.
* **Growth opportunity:** Possibility of a full-time Flutter Developer / Full-Stack Developer role based on technical performance, ownership, and business requirements.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys mobile application development, coding, debugging, and solving real-world technical problems.

The ideal candidate should:

* Have a genuine interest in Flutter and mobile application development.
* Be comfortable learning new technologies and working on existing codebases.
* Understand that mobile application development involves more than designing screens.
* Be willing to work on API integration, backend connectivity, databases, debugging, and deployment.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and complete them with proper testing.
* Be comfortable researching technical issues and finding solutions independently.
* Be interested in building practical healthcare applications that can make a difference in patients' lives.

**Important:** This is a development-oriented internship, not a basic Flutter training program. Candidates who only want to design UI screens without working on API integration, debugging, database connectivity, application builds, and production maintenance may not be the right fit.

Candidates with practical Flutter projects, GitHub repositories, or published Android applications will be preferred.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Join a team that's shaping the future of Advertising & Beyond. At Xapads, you'll work alongside people who challenge convention, embrace innovation, and build AI-powered technologies that help brands connect with audiences across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, marketer, strategist, or storyteller, your ideas have the opportunity to make a real impact. We never ask for payments or fees as part of our hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication or would like to verify a job opportunity, please contact us at career@xapads.com.

  

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/03/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Digital Marketing & Social Media
* City Noida
* State/Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

  

Xapads Media is a leading global AdTech company delivering innovative digital advertising solutions to brands, agencies, and app developers worldwide. With a global presence of 200+ employees across multiple international offices, Xapads combines technology, data insights, and market expertise to drive high-impact advertising outcomes.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years and ranked among the Top 100 Companies for Women, Xapads is committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture that values professional growth, operational excellence, and workplace diversity.

### **ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Social Media and Brand Communications team builds global awareness, authority, and engagement across all Xapads product lines and international markets. The team simplifies complex programmatic, advertising technology, and publisher monetizing concepts into sharp, compelling narratives across social media, digital campaigns, executive thought leadership, and corporate communications.

### **THE ROLE**

The Copywriter will strengthen Xapads’ brand and social communication capabilities by creating clear, engaging, and persuasive content across global digital channels. Operating as a core creative storyteller, this person will translate complex AdTech products, business objectives, and campaign briefs into impactful copy that highlights Xapads’ value proposition. The role independently owns content from brief interpretation and research through drafting, executive ghostwriting, editing, and final publishing handoff while maintaining strong brand consistency across all platforms.

### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **End-to-End Content Ownership:** Own assigned content deliverables from brief interpretation and independent research through drafting, editing, fact-checking, and final handoff.
* **Social & Campaign Messaging:** Own social media copy, campaign narratives, ad copy, and pitch messaging across global brand initiatives.
* **Executive & Brand Voice:** Own executive ghostwriting and thought-leadership communications, capturing leadership perspectives in a credible, authentic tone.
* **Brand Consistency:** Ensure consistent brand voice, terminology, narrative quality, and clarity across all digital channels and client-facing presentations.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Campaign & Social Copywriting:** Create compelling copy for social media platforms, brand campaigns, advertising materials, PR initiatives, award submissions, and client pitches.
* **AdTech Simplification:** Translate technical AdTech, programmatic, mobile performance, and digital advertising concepts into clear, accessible, and creative communications.
* **Long-Form & Thought Leadership:** Develop long-form articles, case studies, blogs, and executive ghostwritten pieces for leadership LinkedIn profiles and industry publications.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with design, social media, marketing, product, SEO, sales, and executive leadership to brainstorm creative concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign plans.
* **Editing & Quality Assurance:** Edit and refine content to preserve accuracy, logical flow, proper grammar, brand voice, and clear calls-to-action.
* **SEO & Workflow Optimization:** Apply foundational SEO principles to web and long-form content while utilizing AI-assisted tools responsibly to support research and workflow efficiency.

### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Relevant Experience:** 1–3 years of professional copywriting or content writing experience in an agency (creative/digital) or in-house marketing setting. A strong portfolio showcasing creative storytelling and campaign execution is essential.
* **Core Writing & Grammar Skills:** Exceptional command of American English grammar, vocabulary, structural editing, and proofreading.
* **Executive Ghostwriting Capability:** Demonstrated ability to interview leaders or subject-matter experts and translate raw inputs into credible, well-structured thought-leadership posts.
* **Research & Fact-Checking:** Strong ability to research unfamiliar B2B or technical topics, verify claims independently, and explain complex subjects simply.
* **Adaptable Tone:** Ability to tailor voice, messaging depth, and calls-to-action based on target audiences, digital platforms, and business goals.

### **GOOD TO HAVE**

* **Industry Background:** Prior copywriting experience in B2B technology, SaaS, digital advertising, ad-tech, or programmatic media ecosystems.
* **Agency Background:** Hands-on experience working in creative or digital marketing agencies.
* **SEO & AI Familiarity:** Basic knowledge of search intent, keyword integration, and experience leveraging AI tools for content research and workflow support.

  

**Life at Xapads Media:**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

  

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (career@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

* Strong knowledge of ASO and App Store campaign optimization.
* Experience running iOS app campaigns on Meta Ads and at least one of Google App Campaigns, TikTok, or in-game advertising networks.

* Hands-on experience setting up attribution tools such **as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or Singular.**
* Strong understanding of iOS measurement and privacy reporting, including **SKAdNetwork / AdAttributionKit.**
* Experience optimizing campaigns for active players and in-app actions, rather than downloads alone.
* Experience in creative testing for gameplay videos, playable ads, and App Store screenshots.
* Ability to share examples of past app launches with CPI and retention figures.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to report campaign performance, evaluate results, and recommend budgets.

description:
1. About Shivit Technologies

Shivit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. develops Shivaizer ERP, a configurable ERP platform built for manufacturing, trading, distribution and other industries.

Shivaizer's existing technology stack includes Java Spring Boot, Angular, MySQL and Redis. The platform includes Sales, Procurement, Inventory, WMS, Manufacturing, CRM, Accounts, HR, Quality Management, workflow approvals, dynamic forms, dashboards and reports.

We are looking for an experienced Flutter Mobile App Developer to develop the first phase of Shivaizer's mobile application for Android and iOS using a single cross-platform codebase.

2. Project Objective

The objective is to develop a secure, scalable and user-friendly mobile companion for Shivaizer ERP, enabling authorized users to:

* Log in securely to Shivaizer ERP.
* View role-appropriate dashboards and KPIs.
* Access ERP reports optimized for mobile devices.
* Receive approval notifications, reminders and system alerts.
* View notification details and navigate to the relevant ERP screen where supported.
* Monitor important business information while away from their desktop.

**Phase 1 will focus on information access and notifications, not full transaction processing.** Module-wise transaction viewing, editing, updating and operational workflows will be introduced progressively in Phase 2 and subsequent releases.

3. Scope of Work — Phase 1A. Login and Authentication

* Secure login and logout.
* Forgot password/password reset, subject to existing backend support.
* Company/tenant selection, where applicable.
* Role-based access.
* Secure session and token management.
* Biometric authentication, where appropriate and compatible with the existing authentication architecture.
* Session expiry and secure re-authentication.

B. Mobile Dashboard

Develop a responsive mobile dashboard displaying KPIs and business summaries based on the logged-in user's permissions.

Potential dashboard categories include:

* Management dashboard.
* Sales dashboard.
* Purchase dashboard.
* Inventory dashboard.
* Production dashboard.
* Finance dashboard.
* Other existing Shivaizer dashboards, subject to API and mobile usability readiness.

Required capabilities:

* KPI cards and summary metrics.
* Charts and graphs.
* Date-range filters.
* Applicable company and business-unit filters.
* Drill-down navigation to supported reports.
* Refresh and data-loading indicators.
* Access controlled by existing roles and permissions.

The application should reuse existing dashboard data sources and business logic wherever practical rather than duplicating calculations in the mobile app.

C. Reports

Enable users to access selected existing Shivaizer reports in a mobile-friendly format.

Required capabilities:

* Report listing based on user permissions.
* Search and categorization of available reports.
* Report filters and parameters, where supported.
* Mobile-friendly tables, summaries and charts.
* Sorting and pagination where applicable.
* Date-range selection.
* Refresh and loading/error states.
* Export or sharing of reports where supported by existing APIs and permissions.

The architecture must accommodate the future addition of reports without requiring a separate application release for every report, wherever configuration-driven delivery is feasible.

The exact Phase 1 report catalogue will be finalized jointly with the Shivaizer team before development begins.

D. Notifications and Alerts

Implement a centralized notification experience covering:

* Approval notifications.
* Reminders.
* ERP system notifications.
* Transaction status updates.
* Scheduled notifications.
* Other supported alerts generated by Shivaizer.

Required capabilities:

* Push notifications on Android and iOS.
* In-app notification center.
* Read/unread status.
* Notification history.
* Notification timestamps and relevant references.
* Deep linking to the relevant ERP screen or transaction when supported.
* Notification handling when the app is open, in the background or closed.
* User-specific notification preferences, where supported.
* Appropriate handling of notification permissions.

Notifications should use Shivaizer's existing notification and workflow infrastructure wherever possible. The mobile application should not independently recreate notification rules.

E. Approval Notifications

Phase 1 will include **notifications for pending approvals**, not a complete mobile approval-processing module.

Examples:

* Purchase Order awaiting approval.
* Purchase Requisition awaiting approval.
* Sales Order requiring approval.
* Expense or payment request awaiting approval.
* Other transactions supported by Shivaizer's configured workflows.

Notifications should display appropriate summary information, such as transaction reference, approval type, amount where permitted, and date.

Users should be able to open the relevant ERP transaction or approval screen where supported.

Actual approve/reject/send-back actions and full transaction-level approval workflows will be included in a subsequent phase unless explicitly agreed as an additional Phase 1 requirement.

F. Reminders

Support delivery and display of reminders generated by Shivaizer's existing systems, including:

* Scheduled business reminders.
* Follow-up reminders.
* Pending-action reminders.
* Due-date reminders.
* Other configured ERP reminders.

The mobile app should display the reminder, its date/time and associated reference where available.

Reminder generation and scheduling should remain controlled by the existing ERP backend.

G. User Profile and Settings

* View basic user and company information.
* Logout.
* Application version information.
* Notification permission/settings handling.
* Basic preferences where required.

4. Future Extensibility — Mandatory Architecture Requirement

Although Phase 1 has a limited functional scope, the application must be architected to support incremental expansion across Shivaizer ERP modules.

Future capabilities may include:

* Sales and CRM.
* Procurement.
* Inventory and WMS.
* Manufacturing and Production.
* Quality Management.
* Complaint and Field Service Management.
* Finance.
* HR and Payroll.
* Barcode/QR scanning.
* Document handling.
* AI Assistant and AI Agent integration.

The developer must implement a modular architecture with:

* Clearly separated feature modules.
* Reusable UI components and design system.
* Centralized API and authentication services.
* Consistent error handling and logging.
* Configurable navigation and permission-aware menu visibility.
* Reusable dashboard, report and notification components.
* Maintainable state management.
* Deep-linking support.
* Versioned API integration where applicable.

**The architecture must allow future module features to be added incrementally without rewriting the Phase 1 application or disrupting existing functionality.**

Where feasible, configurable dashboards, report definitions and navigation should be delivered through backend APIs so that supported additions can be introduced without requiring a new mobile release. Native application changes will still require an app update where the new functionality demands them.

5. Technology Stack

**Mobile application**

* Flutter.
* Dart.
* Riverpod or Bloc for state management, with the choice finalized during technical design.
* Modular application architecture.

**Existing Shivaizer platform**

* Backend: Java Spring Boot.
* Frontend: Angular.
* Database: MySQL.
* Cache/configuration: Redis.
* Existing ERP authentication, workflow, reporting and notification infrastructure, as applicable.

**Mobile integrations**

* REST APIs.
* Firebase Cloud Messaging or an equivalent push notification service.
* Apple Push Notification Service for iOS.
* Secure local storage.
* Deep links.
* Google Play and Apple App Store deployment.

The mobile app must communicate with Shivaizer through secure backend APIs. Direct database access from the mobile application is prohibited.

6. Security and Quality Requirements

* HTTPS-based communication.
* Secure token and session handling.
* Server-side authorization and permission validation.
* No sensitive credentials or secrets embedded in the application.
* Secure notification payloads.
* Proper error handling and logging.
* Testing across supported Android and iOS devices.
* Performance optimization for dashboards and reports.
* Handling of network failures and session expiry.
* Compatibility with Shivaizer's multi-company/multi-tenant architecture, as applicable.

7. Deliverables

* Technical architecture and implementation plan.
* Flutter application source code.
* Android and iOS application builds.
* Login and authentication integration.
* Dashboard and report functionality agreed for Phase 1.
* Push notifications and in-app notification center.
* Approval notifications and reminders.
* API integration and error handling.
* Testing and bug fixing.
* Google Play and Apple App Store deployment support.
* Source code committed to Shivit Technologies' repository.
* Technical documentation and build/release instructions.
* Knowledge transfer to the internal development team.

All source code, project assets, documentation and relevant configurations must be handed over to Shivit Technologies under the agreed engagement terms.

8. Candidate RequirementsMandatory

* 3–5 years of relevant mobile development experience preferred.
* Strong hands-on Flutter and Dart experience.
* Experience delivering applications for both Android and iOS.
* REST API integration.
* Authentication and secure session management.
* Push notification implementation.
* Dashboard, chart and report visualization.
* State management and modular architecture.
* Git and collaborative development.
* Testing, debugging and app-store deployment.

Preferred

* ERP or enterprise application development.
* Multi-tenant SaaS applications.
* Java Spring Boot backend integration.
* Experience with configurable dashboards and reports.
* Firebase services.
* Deep links and notification routing.
* Secure enterprise authentication.
* Experience designing applications intended for future feature expansion.

9. Engagement Model

We are open to hiring an experienced individual developer or engaging a specialized mobile development agency on a project basis.

The developer must provide:

* Links to live Android and iOS applications.
* Relevant project experience.
* Proposed technical architecture.
* Estimated delivery timeline.
* Commercial proposal with milestone-based payments.
* Post-launch maintenance and support terms.

Phase 1 will be contracted as a standalone deliverable. Phase 2 and subsequent mobile capabilities will be planned and estimated separately.

**The priority is to establish a reliable, secure and extensible mobile foundation for Shivaizer ERP, beginning with login, dashboards, reports, notifications and reminders.**

* Defining operating models and governance frameworks.
